facts.claim: In Q2 2026, LG생활건강's consolidated revenue was 1조6,574억원 (+3.3% YoY) and operating profit was 1,028억원 (+87.5% YoY), based on the 7/29 earnings release. An Insight report gives different figures (1조6,526억원 revenue / 2,673억원 OP); this sheet uses the disclosed numbers.

In Q2 2026, Q2 net income was 776억원 (+101.2% YoY), and the article says a one-off US tariff refund lifted results. A brokerage report puts the refund effect at about 150억원; that figure was seen only in a search summary.
In Q2 2026, the Beauty (화장품) segment had revenue of 8,184억원 (+3.9% YoY) and operating profit of 444억원, a return to profit.
In Q2 2026, HDB (생활용품) revenue was 3,776억원 (+5.5%) with OP of 223억원 (+23.1%), and Refreshment (음료) revenue was 4,614억원 (+0.5%) with OP of 361억원 (-15.1%).

In Q2 2026, overseas revenue was 5,845억원 (+12.6%, 35% of total). North America was 2,058억원 (+47.3%), surpassing China at 1,760억원 (-5.0%) for the first time since the company became an independent legal entity.
For H1 2026, cumulative revenue was 3조2,340억원 (-2.1% YoY) and operating profit was 2,106억원 (+6.8%). The Q2 rebound has not yet reversed the full-year revenue decline.

In Q1 2026, revenue was 1.58조원 (-7.1% YoY) and operating profit was 1,078억원 (-24.3%). Cosmetics revenue fell 12.3% and its OP fell 43.2% because of lower duty-free volumes and a restructuring of the domestic business. Yuzhen Investment & Securities (유진투자증권) rated the stock HOLD with a 29만원 target.
After the Q2 results, 7 of 10 brokerages raised their target prices. DB증권 went from 25만원 to 38만원 with a Buy rating and cited planned new channels in H2 such as Sephora and Costco.

On 10/13, DB증권 set a target price of 360,000원 under the headline 'larger incubation costs, lower expectations for the cosmetics division.' This implies a cut from July's 38만원; we saw only the headline, not the body.

Scalp-care brand Dr.Groot (닥터그루트) launched 14 products in 424 Sephora stores across the US on 8/15 (local time). It has been sold in more than 600 Costco stores in North America since October 2025, and its Amazon sales in H1 2026 rose 153% YoY.

On 10/8, 숨37° (Sum37) released the 5th generation of its Secret Essence, with 8,700 hours of fermentation and a 90% fermented base. The line has sold more than 3.35 million bottles since its 2009 launch. Prices are 57,000원 for 50ml and 105,000원 for 100ml, sold through the official mall, Olive Young, and department stores.

The company's own clinical figures for the Sum37 Secret Essence 5th generation: skin turnover cycle improved 56% after 1 week (n=31), barrier repair 62.7% after 1 week (n=32), and skin texture improved 9% after 4 weeks (n=30).

The Whoo (더후) is running a 'The Power of NAD' pop-up at Lotte Department Store Incheon from 9/28 to 10/6. The hero product, Bichup Jasaeng NAD Power Ampoule (launched 10/20/2025), contains 50% NAD Power24™, which the brand presents as 13 years of NAD research.
CNP launched its Propolis and Derma Answer lines on Ulta Beauty's online and offline channels in the US.

angles: Channel lessons for brands entering North America: Dr.Groot went Costco first (600+ stores, from Oct 2025), then Sephora (424 stores), with Amazon up 153%. Practitioners can use this sequence as a template, especially as a guide to whether to start in a value channel or a prestige channel.

How sustainable the Q2 turnaround really is: of the 87.5% OP growth, about 150억원 came from a one-off tariff refund. DB증권's Oct 13 report also flags larger incubation costs. Go into Q3 results (expected late October) watching cosmetics OP excluding the refund, and the China and duty-free numbers.

Pricing and clinical claims in Korean luxury anti-aging: The Whoo NAD (50% concentration, 55 billion liposomes per drop) and Sum37 Secret Essence 5th generation (57,000원/50ml, figures such as 56% turnover) compete with mass brands like medicube's NAD ampoule. Compare how premium brands differentiate in an ingredient-trend war, and the regulatory risk of exporting clinical-claim language.

Domestic channel shift: Sum37 lists Olive Young alongside department stores and its official mall. Track how a department-store luxury brand moving into H&B affects pricing and promotion policy, and what it means for agencies.

content.title_ko: 북미 +47.3%로 중국 첫 추월, LG생활건강 반등은 진짜일까?
content.excerpt_ko: 2026년 2분기 북미 매출 2,058억원으로 중국(1,760억원)을 처음 앞섰습니다. 닥터그루트는 코스트코와 아마존에서 수요를 확인한 뒤 세포라 424개점에 들어갔습니다. 숨37과 더후는 성분·임상 스토리로 국내 히어로 제품을 다시 밀고 있습니다. 다만 영업이익 +87.5%에는 일회성 관세 환입이 섞여 있습니다.
content.body_ko_html:
결론부터: 무게중심은 북미로 넘어갔고, 실적의 질은 3분기에 판가름 납니다

2026년 2분기(4~6월) LG생활건강 북미 매출은 2,058억원(+47.3%)이었습니다. 같은 기간 중국은 1,760억원(-5.0%)이었습니다. 독립 법인 출범 이후 북미가 중국을 앞선 건 이번이 처음입니다. 해외 매출 전체는 5,845억원(+12.6%)으로 총매출의 35%를 차지했습니다. (뉴시스)

연결 기준 2분기 매출은 1조6,574억원(+3.3%), 영업이익은 1,028억원(+87.5%)입니다. 뷰티 부문은 매출 8,184억원(+3.9%)에 영업이익 444억원을 내며 흑자로 돌아섰습니다.

숫자를 그대로 믿기 어려운 이유

  • 2분기 이익에는 미국 관세 환입이라는 일회성 요인이 들어 있습니다. 증권사는 그 규모를 약 150억원으로 추정합니다. (뉴시스)
  • 2026년 1~6월 누적 매출은 3조2,340억원(-2.1%)입니다. 영업이익은 2,106억원(+6.8%)으로 늘었지만, 매출 역성장 흐름은 2분기 반등만으로 아직 뒤집히지 않았습니다.
  • 7월 실적 발표 직후 DB증권은 하반기 세포라·코스트코 신규 채널을 근거로 목표가를 25만원에서 38만원으로 올렸습니다. (한국경제) 그런데 뉴스핌 보도에 따르면 10월 13일 리포트에서는 36만원을 제시했고, 제목에서 신규 브랜드 육성(인큐베이션) 비용 확대를 짚었습니다. 채널을 넓히는 비용이 이익을 깎을 수 있다는 신호로 읽힙니다.

3분기 실적에서는 세 가지만 보면 됩니다. 관세 환입을 뺀 뷰티 영업이익, 중국 매출 감소폭, 북미 성장률이 두 자릿수를 지키는지입니다.

채널: 닥터그루트는 코스트코 다음에 세포라로 갔습니다

두피케어 브랜드 닥터그루트는 8월 15일(현지시간) 미국 세포라 424개 매장에 14종을 입점시켰습니다. 그에 앞서 2025년 10월부터 북미 코스트코 600여 점에서 팔고 있었고, 2026년 상반기 아마존 매출은 전년 대비 153% 늘었습니다. (LG생활건강)

핵심은 들어간 순서입니다. 밸류 채널과 아마존에서 셀아웃을 먼저 증명했고, 그 데이터를 들고 프레스티지 바이어를 만났습니다. 북미를 준비하는 중소 브랜드도 그대로 가져다 쓸 수 있는 순서입니다. 다만 코스트코와 세포라는 가격대 포지션이 다릅니다. SKU와 용량을 채널별로 나눠야 가격 충돌을 피할 수 있습니다.

신제품: 숨37 5세대, 판매처에 올리브영 포함

숨37은 10월 8일 시크릿 에센스 5세대를 출시했습니다. 8,700시간 발효, 발효 베이스 90% 처방입니다. 2009년 출시 이후 누적 판매는 335만병을 넘습니다. 가격은 50ml 57,000원, 100ml 105,000원이고 공식몰·올리브영·백화점에서 팝니다. (LG생활건강)

자사 임상 결과는 이렇습니다. 1주 사용 후 턴오버 주기 56% 개선(n=31), 장벽 리페어 62.7%(n=32), 4주 사용 후 피부결 9% 개선(n=30). 피험자가 30명 안팎입니다. 이 수치를 해외 상세페이지에 그대로 옮기면 국가별 광고 표현 기준에 걸릴 수 있어 사전 검토가 필요합니다.

백화점 기반 럭셔리 브랜드가 판매처에 올리브영을 같이 올렸다는 점도 체크해둘 부분입니다. 올영세일 같은 행사 할인과 백화점 가격 정책을 어떻게 맞추는지가 다음 관전 포인트입니다.

마케팅: 더후는 성분 하나로 팝업을 짰습니다

더후는 9월 28일부터 10월 6일까지 롯데백화점 인천점에서 'The Power of NAD' 팝업을 열었습니다. 중심 제품은 2025년 10월 20일 출시한 비첩 자생 NAD 파워 앰플입니다. NAD Power24™를 50% 담았고, 브랜드는 이를 13년 NAD 연구의 결과로 내세웁니다. (LG생활건강)

출시 1년 된 제품을 성분 스토리 하나로 다시 히어로 제품으로 띄우는 방식입니다. 신제품을 늘리는 대신 함량(50%)과 연구 기간(13년)이라는 숫자 두 개로 메시지를 좁혔습니다. 팝업 동선, 카피, 시딩 메시지를 성분 하나에 맞추는 구조라 중소 브랜드도 바로 써먹을 수 있습니다.

출처

  • 한국경제 (2026.07.30)
  • 뉴스핌 (2026.10.13)

content.title_en: North America +47.3% Overtakes China: Is LG H&H's Turnaround Real?
content.excerpt_en: In Q2 2026, LG H&H's North America revenue (KRW 205.8B) passed China (KRW 176.0B) for the first time. Dr.Groot proved demand at Costco and on Amazon before moving into 424 Sephora stores. Sum37 and The Whoo are using ingredient and clinical stories to push their domestic hero products again. Part of the +87.5% operating-profit jump came from a one-off tariff refund.
content.body_en_html:
The short version: North America is now the center of gravity. Q3 will show how solid the earnings are

In Q2 2026 (April–June), LG H&H's North America revenue was KRW 205.8B, up 47.3%. China came in at KRW 176.0B, down 5.0%. This is the first time North America has passed China since the company became an independent legal entity. Overseas revenue was KRW 584.5B (+12.6%), or 35% of the total. (Newsis)

On a consolidated basis, Q2 revenue was KRW 1.657T (+3.3%) and operating profit was KRW 102.8B (+87.5%). The Beauty segment posted revenue of KRW 818.4B (+3.9%) and returned to profit with KRW 44.4B in operating profit.

Why the headline numbers need a second look

  • Q2 profit includes a one-off US tariff refund. A brokerage puts it at about KRW 15B. (Newsis)
  • H1 2026 revenue was KRW 3.234T, down 2.1%. Operating profit rose 6.8% to KRW 210.6B, but one strong quarter has not yet reversed the revenue decline.
  • Right after Q2 results, DB Securities raised its target from KRW 250,000 to KRW 380,000, citing new H2 channels such as Sephora and Costco. (Korea Economic Daily) According to Newspim, its Oct 13 note set KRW 360,000, and the headline pointed to larger costs for incubating new brands. Building out channels is not free.

When Q3 results come out, check three things: Beauty operating profit without the tariff refund, how far China revenue falls, and whether North America growth stays in double digits.

Channels: Dr.Groot went Costco first, then Sephora

On Aug 15 (local time), the scalp-care brand Dr.Groot launched 14 products in 424 Sephora stores across the US. Before that, it had been sold in more than 600 Costco stores in North America since October 2025, and its Amazon sales grew 153% in H1 2026. (LG H&H)

The order is what matters. The brand proved sell-through in a value club and on Amazon first, then took that data to prestige buyers. Smaller brands can copy this sequence. They will need to split SKUs and pack sizes by channel so club pricing and prestige pricing don't collide.

Launches: Sum37's 5th generation, sold at Olive Young and department stores

On Oct 8, Sum37 released the 5th generation of its Secret Essence: 8,700 hours of fermentation and a 90% fermented base. The line has sold more than 3.35 million bottles since 2009. Pricing is KRW 57,000 for 50ml and KRW 105,000 for 100ml, through the official mall, Olive Young and department stores. (LG H&H)

The company's own clinicals show a 56% improvement in skin turnover after one week (n=31), 62.7% barrier repair after one week (n=32) and a 9% improvement in texture after four weeks (n=30). Panels are around 30 people, so each market should review these claims before they go onto export product pages.

Marketing: The Whoo built a pop-up around a single ingredient

The Whoo ran a 'The Power of NAD' pop-up at Lotte Department Store Incheon from Sep 28 to Oct 6. The centerpiece was the Bichup Jasaeng NAD Power Ampoule, launched Oct 20, 2025, which contains 50% NAD Power24™. The brand presents it as the result of 13 years of NAD research.

The play is to relaunch a year-old SKU as a hero through one ingredient story, built on two numbers: 50% concentration and 13 years of research. (LG H&H)

Sources

  • Newsis (Jul 29, 2026)
  • Korea Economic Daily (Jul 30, 2026)
  • Newspim (Oct 13, 2026)
  • LG H&H press release - Dr.Groot
  • LG H&H press release - Sum37
  • LG H&H press release - The Whoo

This report was compiled with AI tools and reviewed by an editor. It is not investment advice.
content.linkedin_en:
In Q2 2026, North America passed China at LG H&H for the first time.

North America: KRW 205.8B (+47.3%). China: KRW 176.0B (-5.0%). Overseas sales are now 35% of revenue. (Newsis)

Three takeaways for brand and channel operators:

1) Watch the sequence. Dr.Groot has been in 600+ Costco stores in North America since Oct 2025 and grew Amazon sales 153% in H1 2026. Only then did it land 14 SKUs in 424 Sephora doors on Aug 15. It proved sell-through in a value channel first and brought that data to prestige buyers.

2) Read the profit line carefully. Q2 operating profit rose 87.5%, but brokers estimate about KRW 15B came from a one-off US tariff refund. H1 revenue is still down 2.1%. In Q3, I'm looking at Beauty operating profit without the refund.

3) Hero products are being relaunched through ingredient stories. Sum37's Secret Essence (3.35M+ bottles sold since 2009) is in its 5th generation and is sold at Olive Young alongside department stores. The Whoo built a whole pop-up around a 50% NAD ampoule.

The Sephora door count gets the attention. The part other brands can actually use is the order the channels were entered.

Sources: Newsis, Korea Economic Daily, LG H&H press releases. Not investment advice.

cover.headline:
North America beat China.
Is the rebound real?

slides.headline: N. America KRW 205.8B passes China
slides.what: Q2 2026 North America revenue hit KRW 205.8B, passing China at KRW 176.0B (-5.0%).
slides.why: The +87.5% operating-profit jump includes a tariff refund brokers put at about KRW 15B.
slides.action: Buyers: in Q3, judge momentum by Beauty profit without the refund.

slides.headline: Costco first, then Sephora
slides.what: Dr.Groot put 14 SKUs into 424 US Sephora stores on Aug 15.
slides.why: 600+ Costco doors since Oct 2025 and Amazon +153% in H1 2026 proved demand first.
slides.action: Retailers: ask K-brands for value-channel sell-through data before listing them.

slides.headline: 3.35M bottles sold, now in 5th gen
slides.what: Sum37 launched the 5th-gen Secret Essence on Oct 8: 8,700 hours of fermentation, 90% fermented base.
slides.why: KRW 57,000 for 50ml, sold at Olive Young alongside department stores and its own mall.
slides.action: Buyers: check in-house clinical claims (n≈30) against local ad rules.

slides.headline: 50% NAD, a 9-day department-store pop-up
slides.what: The Whoo ran an NAD pop-up at Lotte Dept. Store Incheon from Sep 28 to Oct 6.
slides.why: It relaunched an Oct 2025 ampoule as a hero through a single ingredient story.
slides.action: Retailers: merchandise K-luxury around one hero ingredient, not the full range.
